ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — Generated Op
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: Exercises apply-time enclosing-op attribution live. Ships a C# assembly with a custom `JoofTest.PatchOperationGenerative : PatchOperationPathed` whose ApplyWorker NEWS UP a PatchOperationAdd at runtime and applies it — a child op that was never in the static patch index (the real-world "unindexed" case: an op generated dynamically during a parent op's Apply). Capture must attribute that generated child to its enclosing op as "joof.testharness.genop#N.generated[0]" with this mod's sourceMod, NOT the collapsed "unindexed#" bucket — so invisible-op risk is attributable per mod. No game content — dev/QA use only.
